acquisition_method.evidence: DDA (Data Dependent Analysis) was performed using SAGE software to match mass spectrometry spectra with human protein sequence information provided by the UniProt database.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After reduction, IAA (iodoacetamide) was added at a final concentration of 25 mM, and the mixture was incubated in the dark at room temperature for 30 min for alkylation.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: After reduction, IAA (iodoacetamide) was added at a final concentration of 25 mM, and the mixture was incubated in the dark at room temperature for 30 min for alkylation.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin digestion was performed at an enzyme:protein ration of 1:25, allowing the reaction proceed for 16 h at 37 °C.

instrument.evidence: The fractions were analyzed using a Nano LC-MS/MS system (Thermo Dionex Ultimate 3000 coupled with Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 480).

labeling.evidence: The prepared samples were Tandem Mass Tag (TMT) labeled.

ptm.evidence: Missed cleavage was allowed up to one and cysteine alkylation and methionine oxidation were included in peptide modifications.

reduction_concentration.evidence: Reduction and alkylation of proteins were performed by adding dithiothreitol (DTT) to the EV lysates at a final concentration of 10 mM, and the mixture was incubated at 37 °C with shaking at 450 rpm for 30 min to reduce the proteins.
